GrabC

Connect to first detected camera and use it for acquiring image data. The main thread will wait for the image acquisition and display the BlockID and size of the acquired image. The streaming terminates When the acquired image reached nCountOfImagesToGrab (initialized with 100). If nCountOfImagesToGrab is set to GENTL_INFINITE, the image acquisition will continue forever.

1 /*!
2 \file GrabC.c
3 \brief
4 
5 This sample shows the basic operation of using StAPI the connect, control, and acquire image from camera.
6 The following points will be demonstrated in this sample code:
7 - Initialize StApiC
8 - Connect to camera
9 - Acquire image data (with waiting in main thread)
10 This sample also shows the usage of automatic lifetime management class.
11 Note if you do not use the class with auto lifetime management, you will need to release the class object by yourself.
12 
13 If you want to acquire image by using callback functions, please reference "GrabCallbackC" sample for more information.
14 For more information, please refer to the help document of StApiC.
15 If you want to use the GUI features, please refer to GrabC-GUI.c
16 
17 */

25 const uint64_t nCountOfImagesToGrab = 100;

70  /* Displays the DisplayName of the device. */

84  /* Create a DataStream object for handling image stream data. */

87 
88  /* Start the image acquisition of the host (local machine) side. */
89  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StartAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, nCountOfImagesToGrab, ACQ_START_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
90  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
91 
92  /* Start the image acquisition of the camera side. */

95 
96  /*
97  A while loop for acquiring data and checking status.
98  Here, the acquisition runs until it reaches the assigned numbers of frames.
99  */
100  for (;;)
101  {
102  bool8_t isGrabbing;
103  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferHandle = { NULL };
104  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
105  bool8_t isImagePresent;
106 
107  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->IsGrabbing(&sIStDataStreamHandle, &isGrabbing);

120  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
121 
122  if (isImagePresent)
123  {
124  StApiHandle_t sIStImageHandle = { NULL };
125  size_t nImageWidth;
126  size_t nImageHeight;
127 
128  /* If yes, we create a IStImage object for further image handling. */
129  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStImage(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
130  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
131 
132  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageWidth(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageWidth);
133  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
134 
135  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageHeight(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageHeight);
136  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
137 
138  {
139  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
140  uint64_t iFrameID = 0;
141  void *pBuffer = NULL;
142 
143  /* Display the information of the acquired image data. */
144  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
145  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
146 
147  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->GetFrameID(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &iFrameID);
148  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
149 
150  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageBuffer(&sIStImageHandle, &pBuffer);
151  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
152 
153  printf("BlockID=%" PRIu64 " Size: %zu x %zu First byte = %u\n", iFrameID, nImageWidth, nImageHeight, *(uint8_t*)pBuffer);
154  }
155  }
156  else
157  {
158  /* If the acquired data contains no image data... */
159  printf("Image data does not exist\n");
160  }
161  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->Release(&sIStStreamBufferHandle);
162  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
163  }
164 
165  /* Stop the image acquisition of the camera side. */
166  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStop(&sIStDeviceHandle);
167 
168  /* Stop the image acquisition of the host side. */
169  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StopAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, ACQ_STOP_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
170 
171  break;
172  }
173 
174  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
175  {
176  /* If any error occurred, display the description of the error here. */
177  OutputErrorInfo(psApiFunctions);
178  }
179 
180  if (sIStDataStreamHandle.Handle)
181  {
182  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->Release(&sIStDataStreamHandle);
183  }
184 
185  if (sIStDeviceHandle.Handle)
186  {
187  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->Release(&sIStDeviceHandle);
188  }
189 
190  if (sIStSystemHandle.Handle)
191  {
192  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStSystem->Release(&sIStSystemHandle);
193  }
194 
195  psApiFunctions->StApi->StApiCTerminate();
196 
197  /* Wait until the Enter key is pressed to end program. */
198  printf("Press Enter to exit.");
199  getchar();
200 
201  return 0;
202 }

GrabCallbackC

Connect to first detected camera and use it for acquiring image data. This sample will register callback function for handling image data whenever a image frame is received.

1 /*!
2 \file GrabCallbackC.c
3 \brief
4 
5  This sample shows the way of using callback function to acquire image data from camera.
6  The following points will be demonstrated in this sample code:
7  - Initialize StApiC
8  - Connect to camera
9  - Register and use callback function with StApiC
10  - Acquire image data via callback function
11  You will need to acquire the callback type for further handling. The parameter of each type of callback will have different parameter.
12  Please check OnCallback() function for the example of how to check the type of the callback.
13 
14  For more information, please refer to the help document of StApiC.

52 {
53  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
54 
55  const PApiFunctions psApiFunctions = pCallbackParam->pApiFunctions;
56  for (;;)
57  {
58  StApiHandle_t sIStImageHandle = { NULL };

69  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
70 
71  {
72 #ifdef ENABLED_ST_GUI
73  const PStApiHandle_t pDataStreamHandle = pCallbackParam->pIStDataStreamHandle;

108  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
109 #else
110  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };

112  void *pBuffer = NULL;
113 
114  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(pIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
115  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
116 
117  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->GetFrameID(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &iFrameID);
118  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
119 
120  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageBuffer(&sIStImageHandle, &pBuffer);
121  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
122 
123  printf("BlockID=%" PRIu64 " Size: %zu x %zu First byte = %u\n", iFrameID, nImageWidth, nImageHeight, *(uint8_t*)pBuffer);
124  printf("Press any key to exit. ");
125 #endif
126  }
127  break;
128  }

130  {
131  OutputErrorInfo(psApiFunctions);

134  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->Release(pIStStreamBufferHandle);

GrabCameraEventC

Connect to first detected camera and use it for acquiring image data. The callback function registered will be called whenever the ExposureEndEvent event is occurred.

1 /*!
2 \file GrabCameraEventC.c
3 \brief
4 
5 This sample shows how to register an event callback with callback function.
6 Here we register the callback function to "ExposureEnd" event (Defined as TARGET_EVENT_NAME) with a callback function to handle this event.
7 The following points will be demonstrated in this sample code:
8 - Initialize StApiC
9 - Connect to camera
10 - Acquire image data with callback function
11 - Enable the event message sending function of camera
12 - Register callback function of indicated event
13 
14 For more information, please refer to the help document of StApiC.
15 If you want to use the GUI features, please refer to GrabCameraEventC-GUI.c
16 */
17

251 
252  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageHeight(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageHeight);
253  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
254 
255  {
256  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };

258  void *pBuffer = NULL;
259 
260  /* Display the information of the acquired image data. */

121  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->IsGrabbing(&sIStDataStreamHandle, &isGrabbing);
122  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
123  if (!isGrabbing) break;
124 
125  /* Retrieve the buffer pointer of image data with a timeout of 5000ms. */
126  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->RetrieveBuffer(&sIStDataStreamHandle, 5000, &sIStStreamBufferHandle);
127  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
128 
129  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
130  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
131 
132  /* Check if the acquired data contains image data. */
133  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->IsImagePresent(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &isImagePresent);
134  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
135 
136  if (isImagePresent)
137  {
138  StApiHandle_t sIStImageHandle = { NULL };
139  size_t nImageWidth;
140  size_t nImageHeight;
141 
142  /* If yes, we create a IStImage object for further image handling. */
143  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStImage(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
144  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
145 
146  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageWidth(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageWidth);
147  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
148 
149  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageHeight(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageHeight);
150  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
151 
152  {
153  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
154  uint64_t iFrameID;
155  void *pBuffer = NULL;
156 
157  /* Display the information of the acquired image data. */
158  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
159  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
160 
161  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->GetFrameID(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &iFrameID);
162  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
163 
164  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageBuffer(&sIStImageHandle, &pBuffer);
165  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
166  printf("BlockID=%" PRIu64 " Size: %zu x %zu First byte = %u\n", iFrameID, nImageWidth, nImageHeight, *(uint8_t*)pBuffer);
167  }
168  }
169  else
170  {
171  /* If the acquired data contains no image data... */
172  printf("Image data does not exist\n");
173  }
174  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->Release(&sIStStreamBufferHandle);
175  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
176  }
177 
178  /* Stop the image acquisition of the camera side. */
179  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStop(&sIStDeviceHandle);
180 
181  /* Stop the image acquisition of the host side. */
182  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StopAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, ACQ_STOP_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
183 
184  break;
185  }
186 
187  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
188  {
189  /* If any error occurred, display the description of the error here. */
190  OutputErrorInfo(psApiFunctions);
191  }
192 
193  if (sIStDataStreamHandle.Handle)
194  {
195  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->Release(&sIStDataStreamHandle);
196  }
197 
198  if (sIStDeviceHandle.Handle)
199  {
200  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->Release(&sIStDeviceHandle);
201  }
202 
203  {
204  size_t i;
205  for (i = 0; i < nValidSystemCount; ++i)
206  {
207  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStSystem->Release(&pIStSystemHandleArray[i]);
208  }
209  };
210 
211  psApiFunctions->StApi->StApiCTerminate();
212 
213  /* Wait until the Enter key is pressed to end program. */
214  printf("Press Enter to exit.");
215  getchar();
216 
217  return 0;
218 }

66 /*
67 Callback function for image display.
68 */
69 void OnReceiveImage(const PSCallbackParam_t pCallbackParam, PStApiHandle_t pIStStreamBufferHandle)
70 {
71  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
72 
73  const PApiFunctions psApiFunctions = pCallbackParam->pApiFunctions;
74  const PStApiHandle_t pDataStreamHandle = pCallbackParam->pIStDataStreamHandle;
75  for (;;)
76  {
77  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
78  bool8_t isImagePresent;
79  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(pIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
80  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
81 
82  /* Check if the acquired data contains image data. */
83  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->IsImagePresent(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &isImagePresent);
84  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
85 
86  if (isImagePresent)
87  {
88  StApiHandle_t sIStImageHandle = { NULL };
89  size_t nImageWidth;
90  size_t nImageHeight;
91  const PStApiHandle_t pIStImageDisplayWndHandle = pCallbackParam->pIStImageDisplayWndHandle;
92  double dblFPS;
93  char szStatusText[1024];
94  bool8_t isVisible;
95 
96  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStImage(pIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
97  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
98 
99  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageWidth(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageWidth);
100  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
101 
102  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageHeight(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageHeight);
103  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
104 
105  /* Acquire detail information of received image and display it onto the status bar of the display window. */
106  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->GetCurrentFPS(pDataStreamHandle, &dblFPS);
107  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
108 
109  sprintf(szStatusText, "%zu x %zu %.2f[fps]", nImageWidth, nImageHeight, dblFPS);
110 
111  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->SetUserStatusBarTextA(pIStImageDisplayWndHandle, szStatusText);
112  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
113 
114  /* Check if display window is visible. */
115  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->IsVisible(pIStImageDisplayWndHandle, &isVisible);
116  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
117 
118  if (!isVisible)
119  {
120  /* Set the position and size of the window. */
121  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->SetPosition(pIStImageDisplayWndHandle, 0, 0, (int32_t)nImageWidth, (int32_t)nImageHeight);
122  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
123 
124  /* Create a new thread to display the window. */
125  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->Show(pIStImageDisplayWndHandle, NULL, StWindowMode_ModalessOnNewThread);
126  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
127  }
128 
129  /*
130  Register the image to be displayed.
131  This will have a copy of the image data and original buffer can be released if necessary and original buffer can be released if necessary.
132  */
133  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImageDisplayWnd->RegisterIStImage(pIStImageDisplayWndHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
134  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
135  }
136  break;
137  }
138  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
139  {
140  OutputErrorInfo();
141  }
142 
143  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->Release(pIStStreamBufferHandle);
144  }

163 /*
164 List up the contents of current enumeration node with current setting.
165 */
166 EStApiCError_t EnumerationNode(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pINodeMapHandle, const char *szEnumerationName)
167 {
168  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
169  PStApiHandle_t psIEnumEntryHandleArray = NULL;
170 
171  for (;;)
172  {
173  StApiHandle_t sIEnumerationHandle = { NULL };
174  bool8_t isWritable;
175  size_t nCount;
176  int64_t nCurrentValue;
177  size_t nIndex;
178 
179  /* Get the IEnumeration interface handle */
180  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(pINodeMapHandle, szEnumerationName, &sIEnumerationHandle);
181  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
182 
183  /* Check the node is writable. */
184  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsWritable(&sIEnumerationHandle, &isWritable);
185  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
186  if (!isWritable) break;
187 
188  /* Get a count of the entries. */
189  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntries(&sIEnumerationHandle, NULL, &nCount);
190  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
191 
192  /* Allocate memory for the interfaces of the entries. */
193  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = (PStApiHandle_t)malloc(sizeof(StApiHandle_t) * nCount);
194  if (psIEnumEntryHandleArray == NULL) break;
195 
196  /* Get the entries. */
197  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntries(&sIEnumerationHandle, psIEnumEntryHandleArray, &nCount);
198  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
199 
200  /* Get a current integer value of the node. */
201  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetIntValue(&sIEnumerationHandle, false, false, &nCurrentValue);
202  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
203 
204  /* Display a configurable options. */
205  printf("%s\n", szEnumerationName);
206 
207  /* Get enumeration entries. */
208  for (nIndex = 0; nIndex < nCount; ++nIndex)
209  {
210  bool8_t isAvailable;
211 
212  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsAvailable(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &isAvailable);
213  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
214  if (isAvailable)
215  {
216  char szText[256];
217  size_t nSize = sizeof(szText);
218  int64_t nEntryValue;
219 
220  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetSymbolicA(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], szText, &nSize);
221  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
222 
223  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &nEntryValue);
224  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
225 
226  printf("%zu : %s%s\n", nIndex, szText, (nCurrentValue == nEntryValue) ? " (Current)" : "");
227 
228  }
229  }
230  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
231 
232  printf("Select : ");
233 
234  /* Waiting for input. */
235 
236  scanf("%zu", &nIndex);
237 
238  /* Reflect the value entered. */
239  if (nIndex < nCount)
240  {
241  int64_t nEntryValue;
242 
243  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &nEntryValue);
244  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
245 
246  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->SetIntValue(&sIEnumerationHandle, nEntryValue, false);
247  }
248  break;
249  }
250 
251  if (psIEnumEntryHandleArray != NULL)
252  {
253  free(psIEnumEntryHandleArray);
254  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = NULL;
255  }
256  return(eStApiCError);
257 }

259 /*
260 List up the numeric value of the current setting that the node indicated.
261 */
262 EStApiCError_t IntegerNode(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pINodeMapHandle, const char *szNodeName)
263 {
264  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
265  StApiHandle_t sIIntegerHandle = { NULL };
266  bool8_t isWritable;
267 
268  /* Get the IInteger interface handle */
269  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(pINodeMapHandle, szNodeName, &sIIntegerHandle);
270  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
271 
272  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsWritable(&sIIntegerHandle, &isWritable);
273  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
274 
275  if (isWritable)
276  {
277  for (;;)
278  {
279  int64_t nMin;
280  int64_t nMax;
281  int64_t nCurrent;
282  EIncMode eIncMode;
283  int64_t nValue;
284 
285  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetMin(&sIIntegerHandle, &nMin);
286  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
287 
288  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetMax(&sIIntegerHandle, &nMax);
289  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
290 
291  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetValue(&sIIntegerHandle, false, false, &nCurrent);
292  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
293 
294  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetIncMode(&sIIntegerHandle, &eIncMode);
295  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
296 
297  /* Display the feature name, range, current value, and incremental value. */
298  printf("%s Min=%" PRId64 " Max=%" PRId64 " Current=%" PRId64, szNodeName, nMin, nMax, nCurrent);
299 
300  if (eIncMode == fixedIncrement)
301  {
302  int64_t nInc;
303 
304  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetInc(&sIIntegerHandle, &nInc);
305  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
306  printf(" Inc=%" PRId64, nInc);
307  }
308  printf("\nNew Value : ");
309 
310  /* Waiting for input of new value. */
311  scanf("%" PRId64, &nValue);
312 
313  /* Reflect the value entered. */
314  if ((nMin <= nValue) && (nValue <= nMax))
315  {
316  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->SetValue(&sIIntegerHandle, nValue, false);
317  break;
318  }
319  }
320 
321  }
322 
323 
324  return(eStApiCError);
325 }

584 void* displayChoiceWorker(void *arg)
585 {
586  const uint64_t iNumToAcquire = GENTL_INFINITE;
587  const char* pszAutoFunctionNames[] = { EXPOSURE_AUTO, GAIN_AUTO, BALANCE_WHITE_AUTO };
588  size_t i;
589  bool8_t pisWritable[] = { false, false, false };
590  StApiHandle_t sIStPortRemoteHandle = { NULL };
591  StApiHandle_t sINodeMapRemoteHandle = { NULL };
592 
593  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StartAcquisition(&sDataStreamHandle, iNumToAcquire, ACQ_START_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
594  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return NULL;
595 
596  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStart(&sIStDeviceHandle);
597  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return NULL;
598 
599  /* Use INodeMap object to access current setting of the camera. */
600  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->GetRemoteIStPort(&sIStDeviceHandle, &sIStPortRemoteHandle);
601  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return NULL;
602 
603  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStPort->GetINodeMap(&sIStPortRemoteHandle, &sINodeMapRemoteHandle);
604  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return NULL;
605 
606  /* Check if the camera has AE, AWB and AWB functions. */
607  for (i = 0; i < sizeof(pisWritable) / sizeof(bool8_t); i++)
608  {
609  StApiHandle_t sINodeHandle = { NULL };
610 
611  /* User INode interface to acquire the setting of camera with function name. */
612  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapRemoteHandle, pszAutoFunctionNames[i], &sINodeHandle);
613  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) continue;
614 
615  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsWritable(&sINodeHandle, &pisWritable[i]);
616  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) continue;
617  }
618  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return NULL;
619 
620  for (;;)
621  {
622  size_t nInput;
623 
624  /* Display menu of setting function */
625  printf("Auto Functions\n");
626  for (i = 0; i < sizeof(pisWritable) / sizeof(bool8_t); i++)
627  {
628  if (pisWritable[i])
629  {
630  printf("%zu : %s\n", i, pszAutoFunctionNames[i]);
631  }
632  }
633  printf("Else : Exit\n");
634  printf("Select : ");
635 
636  /* Waiting for input. */
637  scanf("%zu", &nInput);
638 
639  if ((nInput < sizeof(pisWritable) / sizeof(bool8_t)) && pisWritable[nInput])
640  {
641  /* Call the function for setting according to the input. */
642  switch (nInput)
643  {
644  case(0) : eStApiCError = ExposureAuto(psApiFunctions, &sINodeMapRemoteHandle); break;
645  case(1) : eStApiCError = GainAuto(psApiFunctions, &sINodeMapRemoteHandle); break;
646  case(2) : eStApiCError = BalanceWhiteAuto(psApiFunctions, &sINodeMapRemoteHandle); break;
647  }
648  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
649 
650  }
651  else
652  {
653  /* Exit */
654  break;
655  }
656  }
657  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStop(&sIStDeviceHandle);
658  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StopAcquisition(&sDataStreamHandle, ACQ_STOP_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
659  isThreadCompleted = true;
660  return NULL;
661 }

235  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->GetCurrentFPS(&sIStDataStreamHandle, &dblFPS);
236  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
237 
238  sprintf(szStatusText, "%zu x %zu %.2f[fps]", nImageWidth, nImageHeight, dblFPS);
239 
240  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->SetUserStatusBarTextA(&sIStImageDisplayWndHandle, szStatusText);
241  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
242 
243  /* Check if display window is visible. */
244  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->IsVisible(&sIStImageDisplayWndHandle, &isVisible);
245  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
246 
247  if (!isVisible)
248  {
249  /* Set the position and size of the window. */
250  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->SetPosition(&sIStImageDisplayWndHandle, 0, 0, (int32_t)nImageWidth, (int32_t)nImageHeight);
251  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
252 
253  /* Create a new thread to display the window. */
254  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->Show(&sIStImageDisplayWndHandle, NULL, StWindowMode_ModalessOnNewThread);
255  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
256  }
257 
258  /*
259  Register the image to be displayed.
260  This will have a copy of the image data and original buffer can be released if necessary and original buffer can be released if necessary.
261  */
262  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImageDisplayWnd->RegisterIStImage(&sIStImageDisplayWndHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
263  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
264 
265  /* Display each ROI image in different window. */
266  for (y = 0; y < pnROIWindowCount[1]; y++)
267  {
268  size_t x;
269  for (x = 0; x < pnROIWindowCount[0]; x++)
270  {
271  StApiHandle_t sIStImageROIHandle = { NULL };
272  PStApiHandle_t pIStImageDisplayWndROIHandle = &pIStImageDisplayWndHandleArray[nIndex];
273 
274  /* Get the ROI image with IStImage object. */
275  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetROIImage(&sIStImageHandle, x * pnROIImageSize[0], y * pnROIImageSize[1], pnROIImageSize[0], pnROIImageSize[1], &sIStImageROIHandle);
276  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
277 
278  /* Check if display window is visible. */
279  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->IsVisible(pIStImageDisplayWndROIHandle, &isVisible);
280  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
281 
282  if (!isVisible)
283  {
284  /* Create a new thread to display the window. */
285  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->Show(pIStImageDisplayWndROIHandle, NULL, StWindowMode_ModalessOnNewThread);
286  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
287  }
288 
289  /*
290  Register the image to be displayed.
291  This will have a copy of the image data and original buffer can be released if necessary and original buffer can be released if necessary.
292  */
293  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImageDisplayWnd->RegisterIStImage(pIStImageDisplayWndROIHandle, &sIStImageROIHandle);
294  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
295 
296  ++nIndex;
297  }
298  }
299  }
300  else
301  {
302  /* If the acquired data contains no image data... */
303  printf("Image data does not exist\n");
304  }
305  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->Release(&sIStStreamBufferHandle);
306  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
307  }
308 
309  /* Stop the image acquisition of the camera side. */
310  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStop(&sIStDeviceHandle);
311 
312  /* Stop the image acquisition of the host side. */
313  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StopAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, ACQ_STOP_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
314 
315  break;
316  }
317 
318  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
319  {
320  /* If any error occurred, display the description of the error here. */
321  OutputErrorInfo(psApiFunctions);
322  }
323 
324 
325  {
326  size_t i;
327  for (i = 0; i < TOTAL_ROI_COUNT; ++i)
328  {
329  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->Release(&pIStImageDisplayWndHandleArray[i]);
330  }
331  }
332 
333  if (sIStImageDisplayWndHandle.Handle)
334  {
335  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStWnd->Release(&sIStImageDisplayWndHandle);
336  }
337 
338  if (sIStDataStreamHandle.Handle)
339  {
340  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->Release(&sIStDataStreamHandle);
341  }
342 
343  if (sIStDeviceHandle.Handle)
344  {
345  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->Release(&sIStDeviceHandle);
346  }
347 
348  if (sIStSystemHandle.Handle)
349  {
350  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStSystem->Release(&sIStSystemHandle);
351  }
352 
353  psApiFunctions->StApi->StApiCTerminate();
354 
355  /* Wait until the Enter key is pressed to end program. */
356  printf("Press Enter to exit.");
357  getchar();
358 
359  return 0;
360 }

CameraSideROIC

Display acquired image data as divided ROI areas set in the camera side.

2 \file CameraSideROIC.c

5 This sample shows how to set ROI in camera side and handle the image data.
6 The following points will be demonstrated in this sample code:
7 - Initialize StApiC
8 - Connect to camera
9 - Set image ROI parameter
10 - Acquire image data (with waiting in main thread)
11 - Process the acquired ROI images
12 
13 For more information, please refer to the help document of StApiC.
14 If you want to use the GUI features, please refer to CameraSideROIC-GUI.c

48 /*
49 List up the contents of current enumeration node with current setting.
50 */
51 EStApiCError_t EnumerationNode(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pINodeMapHandle, const char *szEnumerationName)
52 {
53  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
54  PStApiHandle_t psIEnumEntryHandleArray = NULL;
55 
56  for (;;)
57  {
58  StApiHandle_t sIEnumerationHandle = { NULL };
59  bool8_t isWritable;
60  size_t nCount;
61  int64_t nCurrentValue;
62  size_t nIndex;
63 
64  /* Get the IEnumeration interface handle */
65  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(pINodeMapHandle, szEnumerationName, &sIEnumerationHandle);
66  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
67 
68  /* Check the node is writable. */
69  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsWritable(&sIEnumerationHandle, &isWritable);
70  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
71  if (!isWritable) break;
72 
73  /* Get a count of the entries. */
74  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntries(&sIEnumerationHandle, NULL, &nCount);
75  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
76 
77  /* Allocate memory for the interfaces of the entries. */
78  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = (PStApiHandle_t)malloc(sizeof(StApiHandle_t) * nCount);
79  if (psIEnumEntryHandleArray == NULL) break;
80 
81  /* Get the entries. */
82  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntries(&sIEnumerationHandle, psIEnumEntryHandleArray, &nCount);
83  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
84 
85  /* Get a current integer value of the node. */
86  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetIntValue(&sIEnumerationHandle, false, false, &nCurrentValue);
87  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
88 
89  /* Display a configurable options. */
90  printf("%s\n", szEnumerationName);
91 
92  /* Get enumeration entries. */
93  for (nIndex = 0; nIndex < nCount; ++nIndex)
94  {
95  bool8_t isAvailable;
96 
97  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsAvailable(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &isAvailable);
98  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
99  if (isAvailable)
100  {
101  char szText[256];
102  size_t nSize = sizeof(szText);
103  int64_t nEntryValue;
104 
105  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetSymbolicA(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], szText, &nSize);
106  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
107 
108  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &nEntryValue);
109  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
110 
111  printf("%zu : %s%s\n", nIndex, szText, (nCurrentValue == nEntryValue) ? " (Current)" : "");
112  }
113  }
114  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
115 
116  printf("Select : ");
117 
118  /* Waiting for input. */
119  scanf("%zu", &nIndex);
120 
121  /* Reflect the value entered. */
122  if (nIndex < nCount)
123  {
124  int64_t nEntryValue;
125 
126  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &nEntryValue);
127  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
128 
129  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->SetIntValue(&sIEnumerationHandle, nEntryValue, false);
130  }
131  break;
132  }
133 
134  if (psIEnumEntryHandleArray != NULL)
135  {
136  free(psIEnumEntryHandleArray);
137  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = NULL;
138  }
139  return(eStApiCError);
140 }
141 /*
142 List up the numeric value of the current setting that the node indicated.
143 */
144 EStApiCError_t IntegerNode(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pINodeMapHandle, const char *szNodeName)
145 {
146  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
147  StApiHandle_t sIIntegerHandle = { NULL };
148  bool8_t isWritable;
149 
150  /* Get the IInteger interface handle */
151  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(pINodeMapHandle, szNodeName, &sIIntegerHandle);
152  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
153 
154  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsWritable(&sIIntegerHandle, &isWritable);
155  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
156 
157  if (isWritable)
158  {
159  for (;;)
160  {
161  int64_t nMin;
162  int64_t nMax;
163  int64_t nCurrent;
164  EIncMode eIncMode;
165  int64_t nValue;
166 
167  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetMin(&sIIntegerHandle, &nMin);
168  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
169 
170  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetMax(&sIIntegerHandle, &nMax);
171  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
172 
173  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetValue(&sIIntegerHandle, false, false, &nCurrent);
174  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
175 
176  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetIncMode(&sIIntegerHandle, &eIncMode);
177  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
178 
179  /* Display the feature name, range, current value, and incremental value. */
180  printf("%s Min=%" PRId64 " Max=%" PRId64 " Current=%" PRId64, szNodeName, nMin, nMax, nCurrent);
181 
182  if (eIncMode == fixedIncrement)
183  {
184  int64_t nInc;
185 
186  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetInc(&sIIntegerHandle, &nInc);
187  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
188  printf(" Inc=%" PRId64, nInc);
189  }
190  printf("\nNew Value : ");
191 
192  /* Waiting for input of new value. */
193  scanf("%" PRId64, &nValue);
194 
195  /* Reflect the value entered. */
196  if ((nMin <= nValue) && (nValue <= nMax))
197  {
198  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->SetValue(&sIIntegerHandle, nValue, false);
199  break;
200  }
201  }
202  }
203  return(eStApiCError);
204 }

207 EStApiCError_t EachRegion(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pINodeMapHandle)

228 /*
229 
230 */
231 EStApiCError_t CameraROISetting(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pINodeMapHandle)
232 {
233  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
234 
235  StApiHandle_t sIEnumeration_RegionSelector = { NULL };
236  bool8_t isWritable;
237 
238  /* Check and set PixelFormat. */
239  eStApiCError = EnumerationNode(psApiFunctions, pINodeMapHandle, PIXEL_FORMAT);
240  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
241 
242  /*
243  Check and set CameraSideROI.
244  Get the IEnumeration interface pointer for RegionSelector.
245  */
246  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(pINodeMapHandle, REGION_SELECTOR, &sIEnumeration_RegionSelector);
247  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
248 
249  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsWritable(&sIEnumeration_RegionSelector, &isWritable);
250 
251  /* Check if target camera (the node represented) supports multi-ROI. */
252  if (isWritable)
253  {
254  /* Multi ROI. */
255  for (;;)
256  {
257  StApiHandle_t sIEnumeration_RegionMode = { NULL };
258  StApiHandle_t sIEnumEntry_RegionModeOff = { NULL };
259  int64_t nOffValue;
260  int64_t nCurrentValue;
261  char chrInput;
262 
263  eStApiCError = EnumerationNode(psApiFunctions, pINodeMapHandle, REGION_SELECTOR);
264  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
265 
266  /* Configure the RegionMode. */
267  eStApiCError = EnumerationNode(psApiFunctions, pINodeMapHandle, REGION_MODE);
268  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
269 
270  /* Check whether the area is valid. */
271  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(pINodeMapHandle, REGION_MODE, &sIEnumeration_RegionMode);
272  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
273 
274  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntryByNameA(&sIEnumeration_RegionMode, "Off", &sIEnumEntry_RegionModeOff);
275  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
276 
277  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&sIEnumEntry_RegionModeOff, &nOffValue);
278  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
279 
280  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetIntValue(&sIEnumeration_RegionMode, false, false, &nCurrentValue);
281  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
282 
283  if (nOffValue != nCurrentValue)
284  {
285  /* Configure the position and size of the region. */
286  eStApiCError = EachRegion(psApiFunctions, pINodeMapHandle);
287  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);
288  }
289  printf("Continue? (Yes:y, No:n) : ");
290  for (;;)
291  {
292  chrInput = getchar();
293  if ((chrInput == 'y') || (chrInput == 'n'))
294  {
295  break;
296  }
297  }
298  if (chrInput == 'n') break;
299  }
300  }
301  else
302  {
303  /*
304  Single ROI.
305  Configure the position and size of the region.
306  */
307  eStApiCError = EachRegion(psApiFunctions, pINodeMapHandle);
308  }
309 
310  getchar();
311 
312  return(eStApiCError);
313 }
314 /*
315 
316 */
317 int main(int argc, char **argv)
318 {
319  /* Initialize StApiC before using. */
320  PApiFunctions psApiFunctions = NULL;
321  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCInitialize(STAPI_VERSION, &psApiFunctions);
322 
323  StApiHandle_t sIStSystemHandle = { NULL };
324  StApiHandle_t sIStDeviceHandle = { NULL };
325  StApiHandle_t sIStDataStreamHandle = { NULL };
326 
327  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
328  {
329  printf("initializing StApiC was failed.\n");
330  return(0);
331  }
332  for (;;)
333  {
334  StApiHandle_t sIStPortRemoteHandle = { NULL };
335  StApiHandle_t sINodeMapRemoteHandle = { NULL };
336 
337  /* Create a system object for device scan and connection. */
338  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStSystem->CreateIStSystem(StSystemVendor_Default, StInterfaceType_All, &sIStSystemHandle);
339  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
340 
341  /* Create a camera device object and connect to first detected device by using the function of system object. */
342  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStSystem->CreateFirstIStDevice(&sIStSystemHandle, DEVICE_ACCESS_CONTROL, &sIStDeviceHandle);
343  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
344 
345  /* Displays the DisplayName of the device. */
346  {
347  StApiHandle_t sIStDeviceInfoHandle = { NULL };
348  char szDisplayName[1024];
349  size_t nLen = sizeof(szDisplayName);
350 
351  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->GetIStDeviceInfo(&sIStDeviceHandle, &sIStDeviceInfoHandle);
352  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
353 
354  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDeviceInfo->GetDisplayNameA(&sIStDeviceInfoHandle, szDisplayName, &nLen);
355  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
356 
357  printf("Device=%s\n", szDisplayName);
358  }
359 
360  /* Create a DataStream object for handling image stream data. */
361  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->CreateIStDataStream(&sIStDeviceHandle, 0, NULL, &sIStDataStreamHandle);
362  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
363 
364  /* Use INodeMap object to access current setting of the camera. */
365  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->GetRemoteIStPort(&sIStDeviceHandle, &sIStPortRemoteHandle);
366  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
367 
368  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStPort->GetINodeMap(&sIStPortRemoteHandle, &sINodeMapRemoteHandle);
369  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
370 
371  eStApiCError = CameraROISetting(psApiFunctions, &sINodeMapRemoteHandle);
372  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
373 
374  /* Start the image acquisition of the host (local machine) side. */
375  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StartAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, nCountOfImagesToGrab, ACQ_START_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
376  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
377 
378  /* Start the image acquisition of the camera side. */
379  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStart(&sIStDeviceHandle);
380  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
381 
382  /*
383  A while loop for acquiring data and checking status.
384  Here, the acquisition runs until it reaches the assigned numbers of frames.
385  */
386  for (;;)
387  {
388  bool8_t isGrabbing;
389  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferHandle = { NULL };
390  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
391  bool8_t isImagePresent;
392 
393  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->IsGrabbing(&sIStDataStreamHandle, &isGrabbing);
394  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
395  if (!isGrabbing) break;
396 
397  /* Retrieve the buffer pointer of image data with a timeout of 5000ms. */
398  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->RetrieveBuffer(&sIStDataStreamHandle, 5000, &sIStStreamBufferHandle);
399  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
400 
401  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
402  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
403 
404  /* Check if the acquired data contains image data. */
405  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->IsImagePresent(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &isImagePresent);
406  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
407 
408  if (isImagePresent)
409  {
410  StApiHandle_t sIStImageHandle = { NULL };
411  size_t nImageWidth;
412  size_t nImageHeight;
413 
414  /* If yes, we create a IStImage object for further image handling. */
415  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStImage(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
416  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
417 
418  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageWidth(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageWidth);
419  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
420

66  free(pBuffer);
67 
68  /* Record the number of times that the memory has been freed */
69  ++m_nDeallocateCount;

129  for (;;)

134  StApiHandle_t sIIntegerHandle_DeviceSubnetMask = { NULL };

153  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);

156  /* Display the current subnet mask of the camera. */

158  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) return(eStApiCError);

160  nLen = sizeof(szText);

165  if (fExit)

335  return(StApiCError_NoError);
336  }
337  }
338  }
339  }
340 
341  return(eStApiCError);

469  /* Create a DataStream object for handling image stream data. */

473  /* Start the image acquisition of the host (local machine) side. */

475  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;

481  /*
482  A while loop for acquiring data and checking status.

485  for (;;)
486  {
487  bool8_t isGrabbing;
488  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferHandle = { NULL };

505  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
506 
507  if (isImagePresent)
508  {
509  StApiHandle_t sIStImageHandle = { NULL };
510  size_t nImageWidth;
511  size_t nImageHeight;
512  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
513  uint64_t iFrameID;
514  void *pBuffer = NULL;
515 
516  /* If yes, we create a IStImage object for further image handling. */
517  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStImage(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
518  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
519 
520  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageWidth(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageWidth);
521  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
522 
523  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageHeight(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageHeight);
524  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
525 
526  /* Display the information of the acquired image data. */

528  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
529 
530  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->GetFrameID(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &iFrameID);
531  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
532 
533  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageBuffer(&sIStImageHandle, &pBuffer);
534  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
535 
536  printf("BlockID=%" PRIu64 " Size: %zu x %zu First byte = %u\n", iFrameID, nImageWidth, nImageHeight, *(uint8_t*)pBuffer);
537  }
538  else
539  {
540  /* If the acquired data contains no image data... */
541  printf("Image data does not exist\n");
542  }
543  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->Release(&sIStStreamBufferHandle);
544  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
545  }
546 
547  /* Stop the image acquisition of the camera side. */
548  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStop(&sIStDeviceHandle);
549 
550  /* Stop the image acquisition of the host side. */
551  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StopAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, ACQ_STOP_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
552 
553  break;
554  }
555 
556  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)

562  if (sIStDataStreamHandle.Handle)

565  }
566 
567  if (sIStDeviceHandle.Handle)

569  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->Release(&sIStDeviceHandle);
570  }

578

Initialize StApiC.

GigEMulticastC

Demostrate the multicast function of GigEVision cameras for sending image data to multiple PC. After a host open a camera with control mode and start image acquisition, other PC can connect to the camera in monitor mode to acquire the same image.

1 /*!
2 \file GigEMulticastC.c
3 \brief
4 
5 This sample shows how to use the multicast function of GigE camera for multiple receivers.
6 The monitor clients must connect after any one client connect to camera in control mode.
7 The following points will be demonstrated in this sample code:
8 - Initialize StApiC
9 - Connect to camera
10 - Acquire image data (with waiting in main thread)
11 - Connect to camera in control mode / monitor mode
12 - Multicast the image data
13 - Broadcast the image data
14 
15 Note: If the firewall is enabled, you may not be able to get the image data.
16 For more information, please refer to the help document of StApiC.
17 If you want to use the GUI features, please refer to GigEMulticastC-GUI.c
18 */
19 
20 #include <stdlib.h>
21 #define __STDC_FORMAT_MACROS
22 #include <inttypes.h>
23

25 #include <StApi_C.h>

32 const char * DESTINATION_PORT = "DestinationPort"; /* Custom */
33 const char * TRANSMISSION_TYPE = "TransmissionType"; /* Custom */
34 const char * TRANSMISSION_TYPE_USE_CAMERA_CONFIGURATION = "UseCameraConfiguration"; /* Custom */
35

158  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
159 
160  /* Allocate memory for the interfaces of the entries. */
161  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = (PStApiHandle_t)malloc(sizeof(StApiHandle_t) * nCount);
162  if (psIEnumEntryHandleArray != NULL)
163  {
164  for (;;)
165  {
166  size_t i;
167  uint32_t nIndex;
168 
169  /* Get the entries. */
170  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntries(&sIEnumerationTransmissionTypeHandle, psIEnumEntryHandleArray, &nCount);
171  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
172 
173  /* Display a list of the transmission type. */
174  printf("Supported transmission types is as follows.\n");
175  for (i = 0; i < nCount; ++i)
176  {
177  char szSymbolic[256];
178  size_t nLen = sizeof(szSymbolic);
179 
180  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetSymbolicA(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[i], szSymbolic, &nLen);
181  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
182 
183  printf("%zu : %s\n", i, szSymbolic);
184  }
185  printf("Select a transmission type : ");
186 
187  /* Waiting for input. */
188  {
189  char szInput[] = { '\0', '\0' };
190  for (;;)
191  {
192  char chrTmp = getchar();
193  if (chrTmp == '\n') break;
194  szInput[0] = chrTmp;
195  }
196  nIndex = atoi(szInput);
197  }
198 
199  if (nIndex < nCount)
200  {
201  int64_t nValue;
202 
203  /* Get the setting of the selected transmission type. */
204  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &nValue);
205  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
206 
207  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->SetIntValue(&sIEnumerationTransmissionTypeHandle, nValue, false);
208  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
209 
210  break;
211  }
212  }
213  }
214  free(psIEnumEntryHandleArray);
215  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = NULL;
216  }
217 
218  /* Get the destination IP address of the image data. */
219  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapDSHandle, DESTINATION_IP_ADDRESS, &sIIntegerDestIPAddressHandle);
220  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
221 
222  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IValue->ToStringA(&sIIntegerDestIPAddressHandle, false, false, szDestIPAddress, &nLen);
223  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
224 
225  /* Display the destination IP address of the image data. */
226  printf("Destination IP Address = %s\n", szDestIPAddress);
227 
228  /* Start the image acquisition of the host (local machine) side. */
229  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StartAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, nCountOfImagesToGrab, ACQ_START_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
230  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
231 
232  if (!isMonitor)
233  {
234  /* Start the image acquisition of the camera side. */
235  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStart(&sIStDeviceHandle);
236  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
237  }
238 
239  /*
240  A while loop for acquiring data and checking status.
241  Here, the acquisition runs until it reaches the assigned numbers of frames.
242  */
243  for (;;)
244  {
245  bool8_t isGrabbing;
246  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferHandle = { NULL };
247  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
248  bool8_t isImagePresent;
249 
250  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->IsGrabbing(&sIStDataStreamHandle, &isGrabbing);
251  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
252  if (!isGrabbing) break;
253 
254  /* Retrieve the buffer pointer of image data with a timeout of 5000ms. */
255  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->RetrieveBuffer(&sIStDataStreamHandle, 5000, &sIStStreamBufferHandle);
256  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
257 
258  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
259  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
260 
261  /* Check if the acquired data contains image data. */
262  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->IsImagePresent(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &isImagePresent);
263  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
264 
265  if (isImagePresent)
266  {
267  StApiHandle_t sIStImageHandle = { NULL };
268  size_t nImageWidth;
269  size_t nImageHeight;
270 
271  /* If yes, we create a IStImage object for further image handling. */
272  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStImage(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStImageHandle);
273  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
274 
275  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageWidth(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageWidth);
276  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
277 
278  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageHeight(&sIStImageHandle, &nImageHeight);
279  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
280 
281  {
282  StApiHandle_t sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle = { NULL };
283  uint64_t iFrameID;
284  void *pBuffer = NULL;
285 
286  /* Display the information of the acquired image data. */
287  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->GetIStStreamBufferInfo(&sIStStreamBufferHandle, &sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle);
288  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
289 
290  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBufferInfo->GetFrameID(&sIStStreamBufferInfoHandle, &iFrameID);
291  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
292 
293  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStImage->GetImageBuffer(&sIStImageHandle, &pBuffer);
294  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
295 
296  printf("BlockID=%" PRIu64 " Size: %zu x %zu First byte = %u\n", iFrameID, nImageWidth, nImageHeight, *(uint8_t*)pBuffer);
297  }
298  }
299  else
300  {
301  /* If the acquired data contains no image data... */
302  printf("Image data does not exist\n");
303  }
304  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStStreamBuffer->Release(&sIStStreamBufferHandle);
305  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
306  }
307 
308  if (!isMonitor)
309  {
310  /* Stop the image acquisition of the camera side. */
311  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->AcquisitionStop(&sIStDeviceHandle);
312  }
313 
314  /* Stop the image acquisition of the host side. */
315  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->StopAcquisition(&sIStDataStreamHandle, ACQ_STOP_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
316 
317  break;
318  }
319 
320  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
321  {
322  /* If any error occurred, display the description of the error here. */
323  OutputErrorInfo(psApiFunctions);
324  }
325 
326  if (sIStDataStreamHandle.Handle)
327  {
328  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->Release(&sIStDataStreamHandle);
329  }
330 
331  if (sIStDeviceHandle.Handle)
332  {
333  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->Release(&sIStDeviceHandle);
334  }
335 
336  if (sIStSystemHandle.Handle)
337  {
338  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStSystem->Release(&sIStSystemHandle);
339  }
340 
341  psApiFunctions->StApi->StApiCTerminate();
342 
343  /* Wait until the Enter key is pressed to end program. */
344  printf("Press Enter to exit.");
345  getchar();
346 
347  return 0;
348 }

53 Adjust GevSCPD (Only for same configuration cameras.)
54 */
55 EStApiCError_t AdjustGevSCPD(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pIStDeviceHandleArray, const size_t nValidDeviceCount)
56 {
57  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
58 
59  int64_t nSCPDValue;
60  size_t i;
61 
62  for (i = 0; i < nValidDeviceCount; ++i)
63  {
64  StApiHandle_t sIStPortHandle = { NULL };
65  StApiHandle_t sINodeMapHandle = { NULL };
66  StApiHandle_t sIIntegerHandle_GevSCPD = { NULL };
67  PStApiHandle_t pIStDeviceHandle = &pIStDeviceHandleArray[i];
68 
69  /* Get packet size.*/
70  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->GetRemoteIStPort(pIStDeviceHandle, &sIStPortHandle);
71  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
72 
73  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStPort->GetINodeMap(&sIStPortHandle, &sINodeMapHandle);
74  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
75 
76  if (i == 0)
77  {
78  StApiHandle_t sIIntegerHandle_GevSCPSPacketSize = { NULL };
79  int64_t nPacketSize;
80  const int64_t nMaxBps = 100000000; /* 800Mbps */
81  int64_t nEachPacketTimeNs;
82  int64_t nTimestampUnit;
83 
84  StApiHandle_t sIIntegerHandle_TimestampLatchValue = { NULL };
85 
86  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapHandle, "TimestampLatchValue", &sIIntegerHandle_TimestampLatchValue);
87  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
88 
89  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetInc(&sIIntegerHandle_TimestampLatchValue, &nTimestampUnit);
90  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
91 
92  if (nTimestampUnit == 0)
93  {
94  nTimestampUnit = 40;
95  }
96 
97  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapHandle, "GevSCPSPacketSize", &sIIntegerHandle_GevSCPSPacketSize);
98  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
99 
100 
101  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->GetValue(&sIIntegerHandle_GevSCPSPacketSize, false, false, &nPacketSize);
102  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
103 
104 
105  nEachPacketTimeNs = nPacketSize * 1000000000 * (nValidDeviceCount - 1) / nMaxBps;
106 
107  nSCPDValue = nEachPacketTimeNs / nTimestampUnit;
108  }
109 
110  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapHandle, "GevSCPD", &sIIntegerHandle_GevSCPD);
111  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
112 
113  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IInteger->SetValue(&sIIntegerHandle_GevSCPD, nSCPDValue, false);
114  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
115 
116  }
117  return(eStApiCError);
118 }

398 EStApiCError_t SendActionCommand(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pIStInterfaceHandleArray, const size_t nValidInterfaceCount)
399 {
400  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
401 
402  StApiHandle_t pICommandHandleArray[MAXIMUM_INTERFACE_COUNT];
403  StApiHandle_t pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Sent[MAXIMUM_INTERFACE_COUNT];
404  StApiHandle_t pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Rcv[MAXIMUM_INTERFACE_COUNT];
405 
406  memset(pICommandHandleArray, 0, sizeof(pICommandHandleArray));
407  memset(pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Sent, 0, sizeof(pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Sent));
408  memset(pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Rcv, 0, sizeof(pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Rcv));
409  for (;;)
410  {
411  size_t i;
412  for (i = 0; i < nValidInterfaceCount; ++i)
413  {
414  PStApiHandle_t pIStInterfaceHandle = &pIStInterfaceHandleArray[i];
415  StApiHandle_t sIStPortHandle = { NULL };
416  StApiHandle_t sINodeMapHandle = { NULL };
417  StApiHandle_t sINode_EventActionCommandData = { NULL };
418  StApiHandle_t sINode_EventActionCommandAcknowledgeData = { NULL };
419 
420  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStInterface->GetIStPort(pIStInterfaceHandle, &sIStPortHandle);
421  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
422 
423  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStPort->GetINodeMap(&sIStPortHandle, &sINodeMapHandle);
424  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
425 
426  /* ActionCommandHandle. */
427  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapHandle, "ActionCommand", &pICommandHandleArray[i]);
428  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
429 
430  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapHandle, "EventActionCommandData", &sINode_EventActionCommandData);
431  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
432 
433  /*
434  Register acquired INode interface pointer with callback function for calling.
435  When the event of passed-in INode indicated is triggered, the registered callback function will be called.
436  */
437  {
438  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INode->RegisterCallback(&sINode_EventActionCommandData, OnCommand, cbPostInsideLock, psApiFunctions, &pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Sent[i]);
439  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
440  }
441 
442  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(&sINodeMapHandle, "EventActionCommandAcknowledgeData", &sINode_EventActionCommandAcknowledgeData);
443  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
444  {
445  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INode->RegisterCallback(&sINode_EventActionCommandAcknowledgeData, OnCommand, cbPostInsideLock, psApiFunctions, &pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Rcv[i]);
446  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
447  }
448  }
449  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
450 
451  {
452  uint64_t i;
453  for (i = 0; i < nCountOfImagesToGrab; ++i)
454  {
455  size_t j = 0;
456  /* Send action command. */
457  for (j = 0; j < nValidInterfaceCount; ++j)
458  {
459  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->ICommand->Execute(&pICommandHandleArray[j], false);
460  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
461  }
462  sleep(1);
463 
464  }
465  }
466  break;
467  }
468 
469  {
470  size_t i;
471  for (i = 0; i < nValidInterfaceCount; ++i)
472  {
473  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStRegisteredCallback->Release(&pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Sent[i]);
474  }
475  }
476 
477  {
478  size_t i;
479  for (i = 0; i < nValidInterfaceCount; ++i)
480  {
481  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStRegisteredCallback->Release(&pIStRegisteredCallbackHandleArray_Rcv[i]);
482  }
483  }
484 
485  return(eStApiCError);
486 }

659  StApiHandle_t sIStDeviceHandle = { NULL };

674  {

688  eStApiCError = SetDeviceActionCommandParam(psApiFunctions, &sIStDeviceHandle);

693  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
694  if (nValidDeviceCount == 0)

700  pCallbackParam = (PSCallbackParam_t)malloc(sizeof(SCallbackParam_t) * nValidDeviceCount);

706 
707  {
708  PSCallbackParam_t pCallbackParamPos = pCallbackParam;
709  for (i = 0; i < nValidDeviceCount; ++i)
710  {

712

714 
715  /* Create a DataStream object for handling image stream data. */

717  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
718 
719  /* Create a DataStream object for handling image stream data then add into DataStream list for later usage. */
720  pIStDataStreamHandleArray[i] = pCallbackParamPos->sIStDataStreamHandle;
721 
722  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->RegisterCallback(&pCallbackParamPos->sIStDataStreamHandle, &OnDataStreamCallback, pCallbackParamPos, &pCallbackParamPos->sIStRegisteredCallbackHandle);
723  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
724 
725 
726  ++pCallbackParamPos;
727  }
728  }
729  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
730 
731  /* Start the image acquisition of the host (local machine) side. */
732  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStreamArray->StartAcquisition(pIStDataStreamHandleArray, nValidDeviceCount, nCountOfImagesToGrab, ACQ_START_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
733  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
734 
735  /* Start the image acquisition of the camera side. */
736  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDeviceArray->AcquisitionStart(pIStDeviceHandleArray, nValidDeviceCount);
737  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
738 
739  /* Adjust GevSCPD. */

741  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
742 
743  eStApiCError = SendActionCommand(psApiFunctions, pIStInterfaceHandleArray, nValidInterfaceCount);
744  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
745 
746  /* Stop the image acquisition of the camera side. */

748 
749  /* Stop the image acquisition of the host side. */
750  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStreamArray->StopAcquisition(pIStDataStreamHandleArray, nValidDeviceCount, ACQ_STOP_FLAGS_DEFAULT);
751 
752  {
753  for (i = 0; i < nValidInterfaceCount; ++i)
754  {

756  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStInterface->StopEventAcquisitionThread(&pIStInterfaceHandleArray[i]);
757  }
758  }
759  break;
760  }
761 
762  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
763  {
764  /* If any error occurred, display the description of the error here. */
765  OutputErrorInfo(psApiFunctions);
766  }
767 
768 
769  if (pCallbackParam)
770  {
771  size_t i;
772  for (i = 0; i < nValidDeviceCount; ++i)
773  {
774  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStRegisteredCallback->Release(&pCallbackParam[i].sIStRegisteredCallbackHandle);
775  }

778  }
779 
780  {

782  for (i = 0; i < nValidDeviceCount; ++i)

784  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->Release(&pIStDataStreamHandleArray[i]);
785  }
786  }

788  {

791  {
792  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDevice->Release(&pIStDeviceHandleArray[i]);

796 
797  if (sIStSystemHandle.Handle)

802  psApiFunctions->StApi->StApiCTerminate();

58  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;

61  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->StApi->IStSystem->CreateFirstIStDevice(&sIStSystemHandle, DEVICE_ACCESS_CONTROL, &sIStDeviceHandle);

102 EStApiCError_t EnumerationNode(PApiFunctions psApiFunctions, PStApiHandle_t pINodeMapHandle, const char *szEnumerationName)
103 {
104  EStApiCError_t eStApiCError = StApiCError_NoError;
105  PStApiHandle_t psIEnumEntryHandleArray = NULL;
106 
107  for (;;)
108  {
109  StApiHandle_t sIEnumerationHandle = { NULL };
110  bool8_t isWritable;
111  size_t nCount;
112  int64_t nCurrentValue;
113  size_t nIndex;
114 
115  /* Get the IEnumeration interface handle */
116  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->INodeMap->GetNodeA(pINodeMapHandle, szEnumerationName, &sIEnumerationHandle);
117  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
118 
119  /* Check the node is writable. */
120  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsWritable(&sIEnumerationHandle, &isWritable);
121  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
122  if (!isWritable) break;
123 
124  /* Get a count of the entries. */
125  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntries(&sIEnumerationHandle, NULL, &nCount);
126  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
127 
128  /* Allocate memory for the interfaces of the entries. */
129  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = (PStApiHandle_t)malloc(sizeof(StApiHandle_t) * nCount);
130  if (psIEnumEntryHandleArray == NULL) break;
131 
132  /* Get the entries. */
133  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetEntries(&sIEnumerationHandle, psIEnumEntryHandleArray, &nCount);
134  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
135 
136  /* Get a current integer value of the node. */
137  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->GetIntValue(&sIEnumerationHandle, false, false, &nCurrentValue);
138  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
139 
140  /* Display a configurable options. */
141  printf("%s\n", szEnumerationName);
142 
143  /* Get enumeration entries. */
144  for (nIndex = 0; nIndex < nCount; ++nIndex)
145  {
146  bool8_t isAvailable;
147 
148  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IBase->IsAvailable(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &isAvailable);
149  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
150  if (isAvailable)
151  {
152  char szText[256];
153  size_t nSize = sizeof(szText);
154  int64_t nEntryValue;
155 
156  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetSymbolicA(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], szText, &nSize);
157  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
158 
159  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &nEntryValue);
160  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
161 
162  printf("%zu : %s%s\n", nIndex, szText, (nCurrentValue == nEntryValue) ? " (Current)" : "");
163 
164  }
165  }
166  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
167 
168  printf("Select : ");
169 
170  /* Waiting for input. */
171  scanf("%zu", &nIndex);
172 
173  /* Reflect the value entered. */
174  if (nIndex < nCount)
175  {
176  int64_t nEntryValue;
177 
178  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumEntry->GetValue(&psIEnumEntryHandleArray[nIndex], &nEntryValue);
179  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError) break;
180 
181  eStApiCError = psApiFunctions->GenApi->IEnumeration->SetIntValue(&sIEnumerationHandle, nEntryValue, false);
182  }
183  break;
184  }
185 
186  if (psIEnumEntryHandleArray != NULL)
187  {
188  free(psIEnumEntryHandleArray);
189  psIEnumEntryHandleArray = NULL;
190  }
191  return(eStApiCError);
192 }

253  {

267  {

273  if (fFirstFrame)

305  psApiFunctions->StApi->IStDataStream->Release(&sIStVideoFilerHandle);

309  if (eStApiCError != StApiCError_NoError)
